title: Gaffney blocked Lockheed-to-Bigelow UFO material transfer

tellings.quote: fact, journalist George Knapp even testified to Congress saying that Gaffne was personally responsible for blocking the transfer of UFO materials from Loheed Martin to Bigalow Aerospace in 2008.

tellings.difference: Told by Knapp himself as a bare naming of Gaffney, with no date or details of the transfer.
tellings.link_reason: Both are Knapp naming the CIA's Glenn Gaffney before Congress as the man who blocked the Lockheed-to-Bigelow material transfer.

as_told.title: Glenn Gaffney of the CIA named as a UAP gatekeeper

plain: The claim is that in 2008 a CIA official named Glenn Gaffney personally stopped UFO materials from being moved from the defence company Lockheed Martin to Bigelow Aerospace, a private space company. Michels says the journalist George Knapp said this in testimony to Congress, naming Gaffney as the man responsible for blocking the transfer. A guest named Dylan Borland, who reports on the subject, brings it up on another episode only as a name: 'Glenn Gaffney, CIA,' pointing to the same congressional hearing. Neither telling says what the materials were or how the block was done. If true, it would mean UFO material sat with a defence contractor and a CIA official decided where it could go.
